decisions.reason: A core-adjacent navigation camera with its own page in both years fits the firm's established offer, and in a growing industry it meets aspirations without triggering search.
The modular camera line has proven heritage through the ESA HERA launch, which exceeds aspirations and strengthens customer trust, so dropping it makes no sense.
The space situational awareness suite is somewhat further from the core and has no reported results yet, but slack and growth in that market let the firm carry it.
The miniaturized LiDAR is only mentioned and shows no results, which signals lower priority, but it fits the firm's strategic push toward compact sensors for small satellites.
The radiation-hard camera line was newly launched with its own page and is close to the core, and space qualification cycles are long, so it is too early to judge it against aspirations.
The asteroid navigation camera is mission-specific and only mentioned, but it links to the successful HERA heritage, and slack allows the firm to keep it while results remain uncertain.
